fusions.name: Far Glance
fusions.desc: A dart of air at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%).

fusions.name: The Clear Centre
fusions.desc: A storm turns round you where you stand, which deals 26 damage that ignores resistance to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves them [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Seen Coming, Turned Aside
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is turned aside and sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Read and Answer
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
